name: Integrations directory filter
purpose: Lets a visitor browse every available integration, narrowing by category and sorting by name.
description: Hairline-bordered (#00251e) block: left 20% sticky "Filter by category" checkbox list (wrapping row at 991, 2-column grid at 479); right 80% header "Showing N connections out of M" with a Sort by dropdown (Name A-Z / Z-A) above a 3-column grid (2 at 991, 1 at 479) of integration cards (logo mark, arrow chip, serif name). OR filter across ticked categories. Same filter layout family as the blog filter but with name sort and logo cards.

placeholderLabel.note: Label drawn inside the neutral placeholder slot (Placeholder.jsx label prop).

assetRef.note: ONLY for roles whose generationPolicy is may-generate-new (ASSET_REF_FORBIDDEN_FOR_PROTECTED_ROLE). Must point at a NEWLY generated file under generated/ -- never /assets/, public/assets/ or a URL. The 56 files in the source project's public/assets/ are the user's local reference copies of the original site's imagery and are never valid here.

logo.note: Integration partner mark; the clone writes the first two letters of the name. No closed-list role fits a third-party integration logo.

motion.note: No section motion; hover only: a grid pattern background appears on the card (transition-all .2s), sort options turn #1ee9b6 (.2s); the sort dropdown opens instantly on click.
